risks.risk: Autofocus and image stabilization may not function
risks.proof: A short video showing AF locking on a subject and IS engaging (switch to ON) with visible stabilization effect

risks.risk: Internal glass elements may have scratches, fungus, or haze
risks.proof: A photo of the lens held up to a light source showing a clear view through both ends

risks.risk: Electrical contacts may be corroded or damaged
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rear mount contacts

risks.risk: Missing accessories (hood, box, UV filter, case)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories together with the lens
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare lens only, no extras

risks.risk: Zoom/focus ring smoothness and barrel creep not verifiable
risks.proof: A video of zooming and focusing through full range
risks.if_unproven: priced as stiff/damaged ring until shown smooth

proof_requests: Video of autofocus acquiring focus and IS switch engaging
Photo through the lens toward light to check glass clarity
Close-up photo of rear electrical contacts
Photo of all included accessories (caps, hood, box, filter) together
Video of zoom and focus ring operation across full range
response.reason: The lens model and brand are confirmed by the witness, but functional and optical condition are unverifiable from photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
